scope: Method 1 follow-up: guarded limited reentry with actual source feedback, not adaptive signal speeds
blocked: No increment when trend BEAR, deep/credit/financial guard TRUE, structural bear TRUE, valuation DEFENSE, source target <=0 or >=1
entry: First available session of each ISO week; completed QQQ close > EMA20 and ROC5 >0; no open overlay position. RULE profiles enter mechanically; MODEL10 requires positive predicted additional return.
maintenance: Evaluate the original source daily on the changed actual holdings. Increment remains while price gate and safety conditions hold. Cancel on the first failed gate/hard guard/full source target. Future source orders are recalculated, never frozen and replayed.
orders: During an active overlay rebalance for target change, entry/exit, or original 7.5% deviation/4% underweight bands evaluated against the amended target. Pure source overweight orders that disappear against the amended target do not cause daily churn. Inactive overlays follow the source unchanged.
branch_labels: At eligible baseline decisions clone source state and actual account. Compare original continuation and a single RULE10 entry. Continue all daily original protections and actual holding feedback in each branch, without any further new overlay entry. Evaluate 21 sessions; censor incomplete outcomes. No future original orders are replayed.

model.weight: each completed source defense episode has equal total training weight
model.admission: Both source episode end and branch outcome end strictly before current decision
model.selection: predicted incremental return >0; otherwise original source
model.scope: No fitting or pooling of old-crisis proxies; MODEL10 stays at BASE in proxy cases

execution: Completed close decision, next open; DELAY1 adds one session. Identical pending targets retain their deadline; different fresh targets replace pending ones. Initial investment follows the existing engine's next-open convention.
checks: BASE paths reproduce StableDelayBacktest under each scenario
Hard-blocked decision targets exactly equal current source targets including no-top-up
Branch baseline agrees with original continuation
Future truncation preserves preceding paths and forecasts

followup_gate.meaning: historical follow-up only, not deployment; MODEL10 has no independently trained pre-2012 proxy model

limitations: All periods have been seen before
Only a few independent defense episodes
Old crises use CAPE and cash proxies
Daily adjusted-price/fractional-share cost model, not live fill or pension-product validation
A hard guard is preserved at the decision close; actual fills wait for the same execution clock as the baseline
